thread:
Jess: Hey all — scheduling for Maya K. (SRE Staff) panel. Candidate available next Tue/Wed mornings. Proposed panel: @Mike @Priya @Anas @Leo. Can everyone confirm availability or drop conflicts? Also need one person to lead the debrief and a volunteer to take notes. Please remember to fill the rubric within 24h after the interview. Candidate profile + times poll: https://redwood.example/candidates/maya_k and poll link: https://cal.example/poll/xyz
Mike: I can do Tue 10–11am PT. Prefer to cover runbook/debugging. Happy to lead the debrief if no objections.
Priya: Tue 10 works for me. Quick rubric Q — are we using the new v2 scoring (5 points per section) or the old 10-pt system? Also prefer to skip Q5 on deep storage internals — not relevant to role.
Anas: I’m flexible Tue/Wed morning. I can take notes if Mike leads debrief. From what I remember, we switched to v2: five sections @5 each (technical depth, systems thinking, debugging, communication, collaboration).
Leo: Wed morning would be best for me. If Mike leads, I can take notes. Candidate asked for a remote-friendly setup — can we confirm Zoom + recording consent will be in the calendar invite? @Jess can you add that?
Jess: Thanks — I updated the poll, candidate ok with Tue 10am PT as tentative. Rubric = v2 (5 pts per section) — rubric doc: https://redwood.example/docs/rubrics/v2. I'll add Zoom link + consent language to the invite and set Mike as debrief lead. Please put any major concerns in the rubric comments field (especially around on-call and incident triage).
CalendarBot: Event created: "Maya K - SRE Staff panel" Tue 2024-09-10 10:00 PT — Zoom link added. Reminder: submit rubrics within 24 hours. Invitees: Jess, Mike, Priya, Anas, Leo.
Priya: One more thing — standard interview format: do we want a take-home or purely live coding? I want to align expectations.
Mike: For this role we decided no take-home. Keep to a short live coding (20m) + follow-ups. Suggest we avoid heavy algorithm puzzles; use a practical debugging prompt.
Jess: Confirmed format: live coding (20m), system design (25m), behavioral + hiring bar (15m). I’ll send candidate a prep note: "expect a short coding prompt; feel free to use your usual tools."
Anas: I’ll log timestamps for each section and paste the rubric link in the interview chat. Also tagging people-ops for consent forms: @Sam — anything we need to add?
Sam: Saw this — consent language looks fine, no extra forms required.
Leo: sgtm. One operational ask: do we allow hints during the coding portion? I usually give at most one hint.
Jess: Good call — limit to one hint per candidate. Locking Tue 10am PT. Everyone please RSVP and set status to "in an interview" for that hour. I’ll ping 1h before with the final roster and a short debrief template. :thumbsup:
